sentences.text: FDA first posted the furosemide injection shortage on 2020-04-07 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
An FDA inspection of Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-05-25, 214 days before the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited on 2020-03-25, 13 days before the shortage posting.
Hospira, Inc. (Pfizer) holds a current shortage listing for furosemide injection with NDC 0409-6102-02.
The recommended action is to transfer 33 vials from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East, which would give Corvale East 12 days of supply while Corvale Lakeside retains 14 days.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
